task: Optimize source FP8 FWD and BWD for all three profiles at 8192/20480 nominal tokens per rank

scope.statistic: Median of 100 per-sample slowest-rank wall times, alternating dtype order between repeats
scope.weights: FP8 weights prepared once outside timing; BF16 normal training API retains its per-call preparation. Additional prepared-BF16 FWD control is synchronous native API.
scope.precision: FP8 E4M3, K128 block scaling, FP32 promotion each K128, BF16 dW for both paths
scope.included: Source activation quantization, communication, checkpoint writes, output handling, release and synchronization; total is independently measured FWD+BWD
scope.excluded: Input preparation, initial weight quantization, optimizer and post-update re-quantization
scope.isolation: No parallel compilation or other test runs during final measurement; benchmark jobs run sequentially
scope.shape_note: 8192/20480 are nominal; per-rank tokens and routes vary deterministically with the benchmark trace.

import os,sys,json,subprocess,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();out=Path('/tmp/fp8-opt3-final.json');records=json.loads(out.read_text()) if out.exists() else []
for repeat in range(2):
 for model in ['qwen35b','qwen122b','flash']:
  build='fp8-opt3-final-'+model
  lib=root/'build'/build/'libweftmoe.so'
  for tokens in [8192,20480]:
   for mode in ['fwd','bwd','total']:
    for dtype in (['fp8','bf16'] if repeat==0 else ['bf16','fp8']):
     key=f'{repeat}-{model}-{tokens}-{mode}-{dtype}'
     if any(r['key']==key and r['status']==0 for r in records):continue
     env=dict(os.environ,CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='0,1',NCCL_DEBUG='WARN',WEFTMOE_TENSOR_EXTENSION=str(lib.parent/'_runtime.cpython-312-x86_64-linux-gnu.so'))
     cmd=['torchrun','--standalone','--nproc-per-node=2','benchmarks/torchrun_training.py','--backend','pf','--model',model,'--tokens',str(tokens),'--warmups','20','--samples','50','--stream-ordered']
     if mode!='total':cmd+=['--forward-only' if mode=='fwd' else '--backward-only']
     if dtype=='fp8':cmd+=['--fp8','--weight-grad-dtype','bf16']
     log=Path('/tmp/fp8-opt3-final-'+key+'.log');start=time.time()
     with log.open('w') as f:
      try:status=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=240).returncode
      except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:status=124
     result=next((json.loads(l.split(' ',1)[1]) for l in log.read_text().splitlines() if l.startswith('TRAINING_CYCLE_JSON ')),None)
     records.append(dict(key=key,repeat=repeat,model=model,tokens=tokens,mode=mode,dtype=dtype,build=build,status=status,command=cmd,environment={k:env[k] for k in ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES','NCCL_DEBUG','WEFTMOE_TENSOR_EXTENSION']},library_sha256=hashlib.sha256(lib.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),result=result,log=str(log),elapsed_s=time.time()-start))
     out.write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2));print(key,status,result and round(result['wall_slowest_rank_p50_us'],3),flush=True)
     if status or not result:sys.exit(status or 1)
